messages:
emma_support: FYI — customer reported a sudden invoice jump yesterday, ~18k billed tokens vs their local SDK estimator ~3k. They attached a curl repro and a short log. Can we get eyes on this?
liam_billing: Can you paste the invoice id and the customer account id? I want to check billing-side logs. :eyes:
emma_support: Invoice: INV-2026-04-72, acct: acct_9X7H. They say it only happens when they call our chat endpoint with streaming enabled and a small system prompt.
emma_support: Customer curl they sent:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this..."}],"enable_function_calls":true}'
```
emma_support: They claim their SDK estimator (node) prints token counts per message and sums ~3.1k. Invoice shows ~18k.
deepak_eng: Thx. Two quick hypotheses: 1) server-side injected tool/system prefill or metadata (kv cache) being counted; 2) streaming/session resume boundary duplication (reconnects causing re-count).
deepak_eng: Ask customer for the streaming session id or request id from our `x-request-id` header — we can correlate. Also ask for a full raw server transcript (they may not have, but logs show reconnects).
liam_billing: I pulled billing trace for INV-2026-04-72. There's a set of tokens attributed to `prefill_tokens` and `postrun_metadata` between 10:12:05-10:12:14 UTC. Looks like ~14k tokens in an internal prefix. 
liam_billing: Could be a model-side assistant system message expansion (we sometimes expand tool outputs into hidden tokens for streaming canonicalization).
emma_support: Customer says they didn't enable function calls explicitly in their flow aside from `enable_function_calls:true`. They do have a server-side webhook that sometimes appends a system hint via the SDK.
deepak_eng: Can reproduce something similar locally. Quick repro steps: run curl with `stream=true` and then simulate a reconnect mid-stream. On recon, the runtime currently replays the last N tokens (we saw a bug where N was larger when `enable_function_calls` is toggled). I can send a minimal repro script.
deepak_eng: Minimal repro (node):
```js
// pseudo-code to cause reconnect replay
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({model:'rwd-3b', stream:true, messages:[{role:'system',content:'You are an assistant.'},{role:'user',content:'Short prompt'}], enable_function_calls:true});
// interrupt the stream after first data chunk, then reconnect the same session id
```
deepak_eng: If the SDK/appends an extra hidden system message on reconnect (e.g., session-prefill for inference continuity), that hidden block gets counted on bill but not surfaced to their estimator.
metering-bot: NOTE: internal metric "internal_prefill_tokens" flagged +14k during timeframe 2026-04-12T10:12:05Z. Related traces: trace_7a3f, trace_7a3f-resume.
liam_billing: Good call. @emma_support — can you ask the customer to: 1) share the streaming session id/x-request-id; 2) run the same call with `stream:false` and send us the payload; 3) confirm if they reconnect mid-stream or do multiple identical requests?
emma_support: On it. I'll ask for the session id and whether their SDK is adding any client-side system hint in a post-send hook. Will also suggest they run with stream:false as you said.
emma_support: Also asked them for the SDK version and the exact estimator command they run (they use `@redwood/sdk` v1.4.2).
emma_support: Customer replied with session id `sess_9k1d` and said they do have a reconnect in their infra (load balancer timeout). They also attached the estimator output: `total_tokens: 3107 (prompt: 1200, completion: 1907)`.
deepak_eng: I'll pull the runtime trace for `sess_9k1d` and `trace_7a3f` and look for any hidden prefill or repeated token injection during resume. If I can reproduce, next step is a mitigation: stop duplicating the prefix on resume or mark those tokens as non-billable while we push a fix.
liam_billing: Keep me posted. If this is an internal replay bug, we should credit the customer for the extra tokens then patch.
emma_support: Quick note to customer: please avoid reconnects for now (increase LB timeout) while we investigate — temporary workaround. :pray:
deepak_eng: Found it in the trace. On stream resume we reapply `session_prefill_v2` block (length ~13.6k tokens) due to a logic branch that attempts to restore generation state by replaying cached prompts. The estimator didn't see that because it's server-injected.
deepak_eng: I'll open an internal PR to stop reapplying the prefill when resume flag is set; also adding logging so `internal_prefill_tokens` is attached to the response metadata for debugging.
liam_billing: Sounds good. I'll prepare a credit note for INV-2026-04-72 pending root cause confirmation.
emma_support: Thanks all. I'll update the customer with repro status and the temporary workaround. Will re-open if they see anything else. :white_check_mark:
